# jacqui.sh

> Personal site of Jacqui Shadforth — an Aussie software engineer and designer based in London.

## About

Jacqui Shadforth is a software engineer and designer with a knack for translating complex technical concepts into everyday language. She obsesses over the details and loves building thoughtful products that delight users.

Outside of work, she is into art, languages, AFL, and Formula 1. She has a deep interest in dark history and dystopian fiction.

## Sections

- [Writing](/writing) — Blog posts and travel writing. Topics include software engineering, design, technology, and personal essays.
- [Reading](/reading) — A curated reading list with ratings and reviews of books Jacqui has read since 2023.
- [Building](/building) — Projects and products Jacqui has worked on, including bułka.com and donutdriven.dev.
- [Creating](/creating) — Creative work including pixel art, baking, and painting.

## Contact & Social
